summary.en: Liquidity is expanding but decelerating. Net liquidity +$53B WoW, up +$230B from April bottom. However, Fed balance sheet dropped -$14.9B in Warsh's first week — a clear signal of structural tightening. TGA released $57.3B WoW to $781B. Two forces are clashing: TGA release (temporary positive) vs Warsh QT (structural negative). The liquidity window is closing, likely peaking in 6-8 weeks.
summary.zh: 流动性正在扩张但减速。净流动性周环比 +$53B，从 4/22 底部回升 +$230B。然而，Warsh 上任首周 Fed 资产负债表即下降 -$14.9B——结构性紧缩的明确信号。TGA 周环比释放 $57.3B 至 $781B。两股力量交锋：TGA 释放（暂时正面）vs Warsh 缩表（结构性负面）。流动性窗口正在关闭，预计 6-8 周内见顶。

fed_balance_sheet_change.zh: -149 亿美元（周环比）——Warsh 缩表已启动

details.en: Net liquidity is still expanding due to TGA release, but the structural trend is shifting. Warsh's first week saw a $14.9B reduction in the Fed balance sheet, proving that QT is now an action, not just a slogan. If this accelerates to $50-100B/month, liquidity will reverse in Q3. June FOMC is the key node for policy clarity.
details.zh: 由于 TGA 释放，净流动性仍在扩张，但结构性趋势正在转变。Warsh 上任第一周 Fed 资产负债表就减少了 $14.9B，证明缩表现在是行动，而不只是口号。如果加速到每月 $50-100B，流动性将在 Q3 逆转。6 月 FOMC 是政策明朗化的关键节点。

reason.en: Net liquidity +$53B/wk is still expansion, but Fed BS dropped $14.9B in Warsh's first week. Liquidity window is closing.

trading_summary.en: 58.3 — Low-Moderate. The market is in the final leg of a liquidity-driven rally. Net liquidity still expanding so don't short. But breadth at 48.6% at ATH is a career-level dangerous divergence. NVDA delivered one of the greatest quarters in history and the stock dropped — the market has priced in the next 18 months of good news. Warsh started QT in his first week. Strategy: ride the trend but hand on the door handle. 55-60% position, defensive tilt, preserve cash for June FOMC clarity. Cut to 40% if breadth breaks 45% or 30Y breaks 5.25%.
trading_summary.zh: 58.3分，Low-Moderate。市场正在走最后一段流动性驱动的上涨。净流动性仍在扩张所以不做空，但广度48.6%在ATH是职业生涯级别的危险背离。NVDA交出人类历史上最好的季报之一股价跌了——市场已经把未来18个月的好消息全部定价了。Warsh上任第一周就动手缩表。策略：骑着趋势但手放在门把上。55-60%仓位偏防御，保留大量现金等6月FOMC。广度跌破45%或30Y突破5.25%，立即减仓至40%。

trading_quote: Ride the trend but hand on the door handle. Breadth at 48.6% is a fatal divergence. NVDA paradox confirmed.

analysis.en: BTC at $77,473 (-0.54%), YTD -30.64%. The divergence between crypto and equities remains one of the most significant unresolved macro signals. Historically, such gaps resolve with equities moving lower.
analysis.zh: BTC 报 $77,473（-0.54%），YTD -30.64%。加密货币与股市之间的背离仍是最显著的未解决宏观信号之一。历史上，这种差距通常以股市下跌来解决。

analysis.en: Gold at $4,535/oz, maintaining high levels on safe-haven demand. Silver $76.93 (+0.26%), Copper $6.35 (+0.83%). The gold-equity ATH contradiction persists, suggesting underlying fragility in the risk-on move.

detail.en: Index at ATH but only 48.6% of stocks are above their 200DMA. This pattern mirrors Nov 2021 and Oct 2007. Speculative frenzy in profitless quantum companies (QBTS +33%, RGTI +31%) confirms unhealthy market structure.
detail.zh: 指数 ATH 但仅 48.6% 在 200 日均线上方。这模仿了 2021 年 11 月和 2007 年 10 月的模式。无盈利量子公司的投机狂热（QBTS +33%、RGTI +31%）确认市场结构不健康。

title.zh: NVDA 悖论 — 超预期但下跌

detail.en: NVDA delivered one of the greatest earnings reports in history ($81.6B revenue +85%), yet the stock dropped. This is the 4th consecutive post-earnings decline. When the best results from the best company can't push the market higher, it suggests exhaustion.
detail.zh: NVDA 交出了历史上最强劲的财报之一（营收 $81.6B，增长 85%），但股价却下跌。这是连续第 4 次财报后下跌。当最好公司的最好业绩都无法推动市场走高时，暗示市场已精疲力竭。

detail.en: Fed balance sheet dropped $14.9B in Warsh's first week. If this accelerates to $50-100B/month, the liquidity tailwind will reverse in Q3. June FOMC is the critical node for confirming this structural shift.
detail.zh: Warsh 上任首周 Fed 资产负债表下降 $14.9B。如果加速到每月 $50-100B，流动性顺风将在 Q3 逆转。6 月 FOMC 是确认这一结构性转变的关键节点。

title.en: Active (Upgraded). Index ATH vs Breadth 48.6% (Fatal). NVDA Paradox. Equities ATH vs BTC -30% YTD. VIX Complacency vs 30Y 5.11%.
title.zh: 活跃（升级）。指数 ATH vs 广度 48.6%（致命）。NVDA 悖论。股市 ATH vs BTC YTD -30%。VIX 自满 vs 30Y 5.11%。

detail.en: Divergences have upgraded to critical levels. Index at ATH while breadth is below 50% is a major structural warning. NVDA's beat-and-drop suggests full pricing of AI growth. The contradiction between low VIX and 30Y yields above 5% indicates the market is ignoring bond market stress. Speculative bubbles in quantum stocks further signal an unhealthy late-cycle environment.
detail.zh: 背离已升级至临界水平。指数 ATH 而广度低于 50% 是重大结构性警告。NVDA 的超预期下跌暗示 AI 增长已完全定价。低 VIX 与 30Y 收益率高于 5% 之间的矛盾表明市场正在忽视债市压力。量子股的投机泡沫进一步预示了不健康的周期末期环境。
